disclosure: All trading here is SIMULATED. No Kalshi API key existed in the build environment, so no order was ever sent; /portfolio/* endpoints were never called. Fills use only prices that appear in the recorded data, and every fill pays the official taker fee.
fee_model: taker fee = ceil_centicent(0.07 * contracts * P * (1-P)); source https://kalshi.com/docs/kalshi-fee-schedule.pdf

sample.caveat: One instrument with 16 usable bars is not enough to judge a strategy. The numbers below describe this recording, not the market.

strategies.name: Momentum follow-through
strategies.thesis: A fast >= $0.10 repricing usually continues for a few minutes when the book is thin and the move is not yet arbitraged back.
strategies.entry_rule: On a >= $0.10 move within one polling window, buy in the direction of the move at the quoted ask, if the ask is <= 0.90.
strategies.exit_rule: Exit at +$0.06 target, -$0.05 stop, or after 180 minutes.

strategies.name: Fade the spike (mean reversion)
strategies.thesis: Many >= $0.10 jumps in prediction markets are one-off sweeps that retrace once the immediate order flow is absorbed.
strategies.entry_rule: After a >= $0.10 move, take the *opposite* side at the quoted ask, if |move| >= $0.12 and the bid/ask spread is <= $0.06.
strategies.exit_rule: Exit on a 50% retracement of the move, a -$0.06 stop, or after 120 minutes.

strategies.name: Cheap tail value
strategies.thesis: Contracts quoted at <= $0.15 on markets with real depth can still be mispriced when attention is low; buying a basket of them is a positive-skew value bet, not a directional forecast.
strategies.entry_rule: Buy YES at the ask when ask <= 0.15 and at least 100 contracts are bid within $0.01 of the best bid.

strategies.name: Favorite carry to resolution
strategies.thesis: High-probability contracts (>= $0.85) held to resolution collect a small, frequent premium; the risk is a rare full loss, so position size is capped.
strategies.entry_rule: Buy YES at the ask when the ask >= 0.85 and <= 0.97.

strategies.name: Threshold breakout with confirmation
strategies.thesis: A contract crossing $0.50 upward has usually repriced its base rate; buying the cross with a tight stop is a cheap way to be long the new information.
strategies.entry_rule: Buy YES at the ask when price crosses 0.50 upward and the crossing move is >= $0.10.
